title: 第二十三章 彻底决裂第二十四章 后天八重
slug: 柳无邪和徐凌雪的小说
content_zh:
所有的笑声，在这一刻，戛然而止！
狂焰地裂虎突然停下来，坐在柳无邪身前，像是小猫咪一样，伸出舌头，发出哈哈声，舔着柳无邪的脚背。
柳无邪则是伸出手，轻轻抚摸狂焰地裂虎的脑袋，后者一副舒服的样子，趴在地面上，一脸享受。
“这不可能……”
万卓然有些抓狂，彻底失去了理智，怎么会这样，狂焰地裂虎被柳无邪驯服了。
他们万家以驯兽著称，掌握的是如何找到妖兽的弱点，逼着它们就范，内心对万家很愤怒，稍有机会这些妖兽就会发怒，经常有驯兽师被吃掉。
眼前的一幕超出他们的理解，狂焰地裂虎是心甘情愿的趴在柳无邪脚边。
无数人揉了揉眼睛，不敢置信的看着眼前所发生的一切，包括徐凌雪，美目中流露出一丝震撼。
“这是驯兽术吗？”
万家的驯兽术人尽皆知，被他们降服的妖兽，老老实实，服服帖帖。
只有驯兽术，才能做到这一点。
打脸！
万家的脸感觉都要被人打肿了，柳无邪挑战了万家自以为豪的驯兽术。
万荣哲石化在原地，眼眸中闪烁出凌厉杀气，今天发生的一切，对万家打击太大了。
“太不可思议了，快拿出记忆符，将这一幕记录下来，一定有什么奥妙在里面，回去好好参悟，也许我们也能领悟到驯兽术。”
一枚枚记忆符漂浮在空中，现场发生的一切，全部记录在内。
“惊天逆转，这个废物还真是让我们大开眼界。”
情况一度有些失控，斗兽场乱作一团，被各种议论声充斥，不少人提到，万家的驯兽术跟柳无邪的相比，太小儿科了。
这才是真正的驭兽之术，让妖兽心甘情愿的臣服在他面前，而不是利用妖兽的弱点，逼着它就范，这是两个概念。
薛玉脸色阴沉的可怕，他们之间赌约，只要坚持一盏茶时间即可。

时间一分一秒的过去，距离盏茶时间，所剩无几。
万卓然目光朝父亲看过去，在等待他的指示，擂台上发生的一切，连他也掌握不准了。
手掌突然做出一个下切的姿势，万卓然很快领悟，目光朝暗中一名驯兽师看过去，同样在等万卓然的命令。
柳无邪站起来，冰冷的目光，扫过薛玉，他们之间的比斗，即将结束。
“咻！”
陡然间！
一枚箭矢从暗中射出来，奇快无比，谁也没有料到，会有人暗中偷袭。
箭矢不大，只有食指长左右，这么小的箭矢，不足以杀人致命，那是为何？并非射向柳无邪，而是射向烈焰地裂虎，嗖的一声没入身体。
狂焰地裂虎吃痛，站起来发出一声愤怒的吼叫，它的双眼，突然变得猩红无比，性格变得暴躁，身体疯狂的冲撞铁笼子。
一丝丝怪异的气体，从箭矢射进去的伤口溢出来，散发到空气中，很快消散，柳无邪距离很近，那种熟悉的味道，进入他的鼻腔。
“迷幻散！”
眼眸一缩，这是迷幻散的味道，当日在青楼，他就是中了迷幻散，才会狂性大发，做出不理智的事情来。
狂焰地裂虎的意识慢慢散去，嘴里发出低沉的吼叫声，身上的毛皮陡然炸开，恐怖的妖气，形成一股旋风，涌向四面八荒。
content_en:
All the laughter stopped abruptly at this moment!
The Crazy Flame Earth Splitting Tiger suddenly stopped and sat in front of Liu Wuxie. Like a kitten, it stuck out its tongue, made a haha ​​sound, and licked Liu Wuxie's instep.
Liu Wuxie stretched out his hand and gently stroked the head of the Crazy Flame Earth Split Tiger. The latter looked comfortable, lying on the ground with a look of enjoyment.
"This is impossible..."
Wan Zhuoran was a little crazy and completely lost his mind. How could this happen? The Crazy Flame Earth Splitting Tiger was tamed by Liu Wuxie.
Their Wan family is famous for taming beasts. They master how to find the weaknesses of the monsters and force them to submit. They are very angry with the Wan family. The monsters will get angry if they have the slightest chance, and their trainers are often eaten.
The scene in front of them was beyond their understanding. The Crazy Flame Earth Splitting Tiger lay willingly at Liu Wuxie's feet.
Countless people rubbed their eyes and looked at what was happening in front of them in disbelief, including Xu Lingxue, with a hint of shock in her beautiful eyes.
"Is this an animal taming technique?"
Everyone knows the Wan family's beast-taming skills, and the monsters they subdue are honest and obedient.
Only the art of animal taming can do this.
Slap in the face!
Wan Jia's face felt like it was swollen from being beaten, and Liu Wuxie challenged Wan Jia's proud animal taming skills.
Wan Rongzhe was petrified on the spot, with murderous intent flashing in his eyes. Everything that happened today had a huge impact on the Wan family.
"It's incredible. Take out the memory charm and record this scene. There must be some secret in it. Go back and study it carefully. Maybe we can also understand the art of taming animals."
Memory charms floated in the air, recording everything that happened at the scene.
"A shocking turn of events, this piece of trash really opened our eyes."
The situation got a little out of control for a while, and the Colosseum was in chaos and filled with all kinds of discussions. Many people mentioned that Wanjia's animal training skills were too childish compared to Liu Wuxie's.
This is the true art of controlling beasts, making the monster willingly surrender in front of him, instead of taking advantage of the monster's weakness and forcing it to submit. These are two concepts.
Xue Yu's face was gloomy and terrible. They made a bet that they only had to insist on having a cup of tea.
Time passed by minute by minute, and there was not much time left for tea.
Wan Zhuoran looked towards his father, waiting for his instructions. Even he couldn't control what happened in the ring.
The palm of his hand suddenly made a downward motion. Wan Zhuoran quickly understood and looked towards a trainer in the dark, also waiting for Wan Zhuoran's order.
Liu Wuxie stood up and glanced at Xue Yu with his cold eyes. The fight between them was about to end.
"Phew!"
Suddenly!
An arrow shot out from the darkness at an extremely fast speed. No one expected that someone would sneak up on him secretly.
The arrow is not big, only about the length of the index finger. Such a small arrow is not fatal enough to kill people. Why? It was not shot at Liu Wuxie, but at the Fiery Earth Splitting Tiger, and it sank into the body with a whooshing sound.
The Crazy Flame Earth Splitting Tiger was in pain, stood up and let out an angry roar. Its eyes suddenly became extremely scarlet, its character became violent, and its body rushed against the iron cage crazily.
A trace of weird gas overflowed from the wound where the arrow was shot, spread into the air, and quickly dissipated. Liu Wuxie was very close, and that familiar smell entered his nasal cavity.
"Psychedelic Powder!"
His eyes narrowed, this was the smell of Psychedelic Powder. That day at the brothel, he was hit by Psychedelic Powder, which made him go crazy and do irrational things.
The consciousness of the Crazy Flame Earth Splitting Tiger slowly dissipated, and a low roar came from his mouth. The fur on his body suddenly exploded, and the terrifying demonic energy formed a whirlwind and surged into all directions.
